boundary_judgement_recorded.finding: requested_currentness_claim is a free-form caller string, refused only when it is CONFLICTING/UNKNOWN/MISSING/UNRESOLVED. Any other string is accepted and becomes currentness_result in the material.
boundary_judgement_recorded.assessment: the binder decides nothing about currency and refuses the negative cases, but the accepted vocabulary is unconstrained and unpinned by any test

finding_F1_single_source_mode_is_decorat.claim: SINGLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION requires requested_source_universe_ref and records it in the material and replay identity, but does not constrain evaluation
finding_F1_single_source_mode_is_decorat.root_cause: evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility calls assert_query_source_admitted(query), which tests the QUERY's source against self.admitted_source_universe_refs (the whole admitted set), never against requested_source_universe_ref
finding_F1_single_source_mode_is_decorat.related: a single-source binding requesting BB is accepted even when the F8 rule's source_universe_refs does not contain BB, because the rule check compares against the admitted set, not the requested source
finding_F1_single_source_mode_is_decorat.mode_difference: the two declared modes differ only in whether set exposure is gated by coverage
finding_F1_single_source_mode_is_decorat.court_coverage: no court test pins this; the single-source tests assert only that a NON-ADMITTED requested source refuses
finding_F1_single_source_mode_is_decorat.why: every evaluable source is positively admitted and the narrowing never widens, but a declared refinement is inert

finding_F2_positive_power_enumeration_is.assessment: evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility is NOT a new authority - it delegates to the adopted F8 evaluator unchanged, verified on geometry and identity. The candidate's substantive statement 'no method that returns a chosen source' is TRUE and I could not falsify it. What is false is the counting: the declared public surface has five returning callables, one of which performs a full F8 evaluation. No third power over SOURCES is reachable; a third returning FUNCTION is, and it is exported.
finding_F2_positive_power_enumeration_is.commission_relevance: the commission asked whether any third positive power is reachable through helper methods or returned material; the honest answer is that one is reachable and is part of __all__
